clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Death Cap grows in the cave behind Cliffspring Falls. Night elf herbalists seek the scarce fungus, but the Grove of the Ancients warns against approaching the falls.

Death Cap grows in the damp cave behind Cliffspring Falls, along Darkshore's northeastern mountain ridges. Scaber stalks carpet the cavern floor, but Death Cap is scarce. Night elf herbalists such as Barithras Moonshade value it for experimental brewing. Finding even one means entering a cavern the Grove of the Ancients warns against, where corruption is taking root.
